challenge.reason: Offline same-provider calibration only. Persisting resolved API keys to credentials.json breaks the environment-only secret boundary. Gitignore prevents ordinary tracking but does not prevent local reads, backups or retention of plaintext credentials. A small claimed process.env lookup saving does not justify that security change; caching in memory would avoid disk persistence. The supersession argument is unsound.
